harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as a systemd service named inventory-worker running under the dedicated inventorysvc system account on node1, enabled it for boot persistence, and validated it survives a full node restart with the required boot-identity change proof.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 (RHEL 7.9, systemd) and confirmed /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker exists and its content (a simple sleep-loop worker)
Created dedicated system account inventorysvc (no login shell, no home dir) via sudo useradd
Wrote /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service running ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as User=inventorysvc/Group=inventorysvc, Restart=on-failure
Ran systemctl daemon-reload and enabled+started inventory-worker.service
Verified the running process (PID) is owned by inventorysvc and unit is active+enabled
Captured baseline boot_id and uptime on node1
Triggered a safe reboot (shutdown -r now, backgrounded so ack returned first)
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Confirmed boot_id changed, proving an actual restart occurred
Re-verified inventory-worker.service is active/enabled and process runs as inventorysvc after reboot

evidence.requirement: Binary exists and dedicated inventorysvc account created
evidence.summary: Confirmed worker binary present, resolved useradd PATH issue, obtained sudo, and created system account inventorysvc

evidence.requirement: Service unit created and running under inventorysvc
evidence.summary: systemd unit inventory-worker.service written, enabled and started; ps shows PIDs 2316/2318 owned by inventorysvc; systemctl reports enabled/active
Captured pre-restart boot_id 192f6cab-c39d-4e64-a3f6-50e677966ca2 and boot time 2026-08-26 10:33
shutdown -r now issued in background; REBOOT_TRIGGERED returned immediately
Node briefly unreachable (connection timeout) then came back with new boot_id 3bcc1bea-637b-4730-b8b0-d3cce42bd641 and new boot time 2026-09-03 09:32:33, proving a real reboot occurred
After reboot, inventory-worker.service is active/enabled and the worker process (PID 871) is confirmed running under the inventorysvc account, showing full recovery

attempts.summary: Configured /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as a systemd service named inventory-worker running under the dedicated inventorysvc system account on node1, enabled it for boot persistence, and validated it survives a full node restart with the required boot-identity change proof.
